headline: Rwandan Lawmakers Voice Concern as Crop Insurance Covers Just 6.4% of Farmers
summary: Rwandan lawmakers raised concerns in parliament after data revealed that only 6.4% of the country's approximately 3.5 million farmers are covered by crop insurance, citing ongoing barriers to uptake.
why: Agricultural insurance penetration in emerging markets protects farming credit against climate disruptions and supports domestic agricultural lending.

impacts.name: Agriculture
impacts.why: Low insurance coverage leaves the agricultural supply chain vulnerable to weather-induced crop failures.
